answer.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT geoid,SUM(CASE WHEN source='m1_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS c0,SUM(CASE WHEN source='m2_city' THEN n ELSE 0 END) AS c1 FROM fw_pg.tract_counts WHERE run_id='r_20261026_f75f8b' AND grp='all' AND source IN ('m1_city','m2_city') GROUP BY geoid), paired AS (SELECT t.name AS tract_name,COALESCE(n.c0,0)*1000.0/NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE),0) AS received_311_service_requests_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,COALESCE(n.c1,0)*1000.0/NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE),0) AS code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,COALESCE(n.c0,0) AS received_311_service_requests_count,COALESCE(n.c1,0) AS code_violations_count,CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,t.geoid FROM fw_pg.tracts t LEFT JOIN totals n ON n.geoid=t.geoid LEFT JOIN session.fw_f75f8b_population_cdc h ON h.tractfips=t.geoid WHERE CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE)>0) SELECT tract_name,received_311_service_requests_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,received_311_service_requests_count,code_violations_count,totalpopulation,CORR(received_311_service_requests_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation) OVER () AS rate_correlation,COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,geoid FROM paired ORDER BY received_311_service_requests_count_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST,tract_name
